description: Synthetic qualitative corpora for demos and tests. Inspired by the Qualitative-Text-Datasets-for-UX-Research collection; all content is fictional.

datasets.title: Mobile Banking Onboarding Interview
datasets.summary: A first-time user describes friction during identity verification, cluttered navigation, and intrusive marketing.

datasets.title: Open-Ended Survey Responses
datasets.summary: Short user responses about frustrations with notifications, performance, search, pricing, and support.

datasets.title: Teaching Reflection (Intro CS Lecture)
datasets.summary: An instructor's reflection on a failed explanation of loops, surfacing assumptions about curriculum order.

datasets.title: Product Survey (CSV, tabular mode)
datasets.summary: A 60-row survey export with IDs, Likert scores, dates, and a free-text feedback column — exercises the column picker and row-cited evidence.
